info.name: NetTriage AI
info.description:
API collection for NetTriage AI — a multi-agent log triage pipeline using LangGraph.

Live endpoint: https://nettriage-ai.onrender.com

Includes test scenarios for:
- Health check
- Brute force attack
- Port scanning
- Data exfiltration
- Privilege escalation
- DDoS attack
- Normal traffic (should NOT flag anomaly)
